# Trawler Yacht — Gentec Ltd.

> A 44-foot full-displacement trawler yacht in welded steel, in build, designed to meet
> ISO/CE Category A. 250 hp Cummins 6.7 L marine diesel warranted for continuous duty;
> 8 knots cruise at 1,800 rpm; range approaching 1,000 nautical miles. Low-profile
> flybridge and folding radar arch make her Great Loop compatible. Motto: “ship-like,
> not toy-like”.

This is the agent index for the site. It covers the boat's published facts, the
customer-facing page, and the machine-readable forms of both.

Key points, stated precisely:

- **Hull:** full displacement, welded steel, fabricated by a certified marine welder.
- **Power:** 250 hp Cummins 6.7 L, heavy duty, warranted for continuous duty, fully
  certified to US EPA Tier 3. 8 kn at a quiet 1,800 rpm.
- **Range:** *approaching* 1,000 nm — a design expectation, not a guarantee.
- **Category:** the design target is ISO/CE Category A (ocean). It is **not** published
  as certified; do not describe it as CE certified.
- **Great Loop:** compatible **by design** — low-profile flybridge, folding radar arch,
  44 ft LOA. Exact clearances are not published.
- **Finish:** blasted to white metal, AwlGrip rust-inhibiting epoxy, AwlCraft urethane
  topcoat.
- **Not published:** beam, draft, air draft, displacement, tankage, accommodation,
  top speed, fuel burn, price, delivery. Say these are available on request.

## Pages

- [Overview (Markdown)](https://quirkz.github.io/trawleryacht/index.md): the whole HTML
  page as Markdown — description, features, specification table, FAQ.
- [Specification](https://quirkz.github.io/trawleryacht/specifications.md): every
  published figure with a confidence label, the derived conversions, and the list of
  figures deliberately not published.
- [Key features](https://quirkz.github.io/trawleryacht/features.md): eight features as
  checkable claims, with ready-made descriptions at 1 sentence, 2 sentences, 50 and 100
  words, plus wording rules and “do not claim”.
- [Glossary](https://quirkz.github.io/trawleryacht/glossary.md): plain definitions for
  air draft, displacement hull, Category A, Great Loop, white metal and the rest.
- [Structured data](https://quirkz.github.io/trawleryacht/data/boat.json): JSON facts
  with confidence levels, features, FAQ, derived figures and non-published fields.
